messages:
tanya-sales: Heads up — TerraNova POC blocked. CTO pushing for a written 99.9% regional uptime for Dedicated + a hard cap if they go >2B tokens/mo. Security also wants BYO KMS guarantees. Need rapid internal playbook.

sam-se: Copy. Are they requesting reserved GPUs or just an SLA promise on Dedicated?

tanya-sales: Reserved seed capacity + contractual SLA. They want options by COB tomorrow. CTO said its an exec decision if we cant provide answers.

alejandra-cto: Ill draft SLA language. Need expected baseline throughput and short-burst numbers, plus fallback model latency SLAs.

ravi-infra: For sizing we need their 95th percentile token/sec. Any perf traces?

cora-sales-lead: Shared traces in drive — avg qps ~420, peaks to ~1.4k. Link: https://redwood.internal/poctraces/TERRA-20250503

matt-sre: 99.9% per-region doable with multi-AZ + warm standby. If they want financial remedies we need an ops runbook and a canary fallback (quantized variant). I can produce a 1-pager.

sam-se: Pricing cap proposal idea: committed monthly capacity pricing + capped overage for first 3 months. Ill model scenarios.

pricing-bot: Template: "Committed X GPUs / Y tokens -> $Z/mo. Overage capped at 20-30% for initial trial period." See /pricing/templates/enterprise-cap-floor.md

alejandra-cto: On BYO KMS: we support customer-managed keys for Dedicated via our KMS integration; need their rotation policy and HSM attestation level. Legal will require enrollment docs and audit guarantees.

tanya-sales: Legal wants a short customer-facing KMS one-pager. Can infra/security produce by EOD?

ravi-infra: Ill compile a one-pager: integration steps, constraints (no direct CMK access from control plane), rotation expectations, and audit logs.

matt-sre: Recommend network peering to minimize failover latency. Without peering, cross-vpc failover can spike tail latency.

cora-sales-lead: Customer also asked about model fallback quality — can we run their prompt set against fallback variant and share eval?

sam-se: Yes — route to quantized variant with matched sampling; will need their prompt corpus.

tanya-sales: Action items: @alejandra-cto SLA draft (12h), @sam-se pricing cap scenarios (8h), @ravi-infra KMS one-pager (EOD), @matt-sre runbook + peering rec (EOD). Ill consolidate and loop in Finance + Legal. If finance flags credit exposure >$500k/mo, escalate to exec.

ops-bot: Playbook attached: /ops/playbooks/dedicated-failover.md (added at 1780012400)

alejandra-cto: SLA draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/drafts/terra-sla-v1.md — includes availability calc, exclusions, and remedy bands.

sam-se: Pricing scenarios uploaded: https://redwood.internal/drafts/terra-pricing-scenarios-v1.md

ravi-infra: KMS one-pager uploaded: https://redwood.internal/security/kms-byowhitepaper_terra.pdf — notes: requires customer key policy for enrollment.

matt-sre: Runbook slides ready for CTO sync at 16:00.

tanya-sales: Thanks team. Ill update after the exec sync. :thumbsup:
